description: Organizational chart titled 'Figure 3.1: FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation' (the DOJ Inspector General report figure on the Clinton email investigation), overlaid with red hand-added annotations tracking each official's fate. 'FIRED' is stamped beside James Comey, Jim Rybicki, Lisa Page, Andrew McCabe, Mark Giuliano, Michael Steinbach, John Giacalone, Jim Baker, Trisha Anderson and Pete Strzok; 'Removed' beside the Counterintelligence Division box (E.W. 'Bill' Priestap); 'TRACK' beside Tashina 'Tash' Gauhar and Sally Moyer; and 'CO-OP' beside Kevin Clinesmith. The annotations are an anon's claims about firings/cooperation, not part of the original IG figure.
text: Figure 3.1: FBI Chain of Command for the Midyear Investigation. FIRED. FBI Director James Comey. FIRED. Chief of Staff Jim Rybicki. FIRED. Special Counsel Lisa Page (February 2016-March 2018). Deputy Director Andrew McCabe (February 2016-March 2018) Mark Giuliano (November 2013-January 2016). FIRED. FIRED. FIRED. NSB EAD Michael Steinbach (February 2016-February 2017) John Giacalone (July 2015-February 2016). FIRED. Office of General Counsel Jim Baker. FIRED. AD Counterintelligence Division (CD) E.W. 'Bill' Priestap (January 2016-Present) Randy Coleman (May 2014-December 2015). NSCLB Deputy General Counsel Trisha Anderson. FIRED. Removed. NSCLB Attorneys FBI Attorney 1 FBI Attorney 2. FIRED. Agent Lead Pete Strzok. Lead Analyst. TRACK. Tashina 'Tash' Gauhar FBI Attorney 1. Kevin Clinesmith FBI Attorney 2. CO-OP. Supervisory Special Agent Sally Moyer. TRACK.
orgs: Department of Justice Office of Inspector General
flags: Red 'FIRED'/'Removed'/'TRACK'/'CO-OP' annotations are an anonymous poster's claims overlaid on the official IG figure; employment-status claims are unverified as presented

description: Screenshot of Q drop #4570 (2 Jul 2020) as rendered in a Q aggregator app, titled 'Three Sex Abusers/Traffickers Down: Harvey Weinstein, Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell'. The attached photograph shows three formally dressed guests outdoors with red X marks drawn over each face: Harvey Weinstein in a tuxedo, a man in a white naval dress-uniform costume with medals, and Ghislaine Maxwell in a red feathered fascinator. The image is consistent with the widely published photo of Weinstein, Jeffrey Epstein and Maxwell at Princess Beatrice's 18th-birthday party at Windsor Castle in July 2006.

Four demonstrators stand in front of the mirrored sculpture holding hand-made banners reading 'FOR GOD AND COUNTRY', 'PATRIOTS FIGHT', and a large black 'Q', with the Chicago skyline and crowds of park visitors reflected in the sculpture. A watermark credits the photo to Veronica Wolski.
